topic: Luffy made Brook's promise to Laboon in chapter 105; Brook's dream is the circle back to Reverse Mountain
title: Luffy Made Brook's Promise Before Brook Existed
description: Luffy promised Laboon a rematch in chapter 105, 337 chapters before Brook appeared. Here is why Brook's promise to the whale may be how One Piece really ends. Do you buy it?
comment: Does One Piece end at Laugh Tale, or back at Reverse Mountain with Brook and Laboon? Pick one.

lines.text: People say the ending is Laugh Tale. Here's my read: that's the middle.
I think the last scene is Brook playing that song to a whale wearing Luffy's flag.

lines.text: Joy Boy broke his promise. This crew keeps theirs.
Oda planted that ending long before anyone met the skeleton, because
